name: push_job_http_trigger_033
query: create extension if not exists pg_net with schema extensions; create or replace function public.invoke_push_notification_edge_function() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public, extensions as $$ declare v_request_id bigint; begin select net.http_post(url := 'https://pbsythpzncjoafpmijyd.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-push-notification', headers := '{"Content-Type":"application/json"}'::jsonb, body := jsonb_build_object('record', to_jsonb(new))) into v_request_id; return new; exception when others then raise warning 'push notification HTTP trigger failed: %', sqlerrm; return new; end; $$; drop trigger if exists trg_push_job_invoke_edge_function on public.push_notification_jobs; create trigger trg_push_job_invoke_edge_function after insert on public.push_notification_jobs for each row execute function public.invoke_push_notification_edge_function()
